text:
I’ll inspect the app structure, metadata, crawl/indexing controls, structured data, and content signals, then report only evidence-backed issues with exact file and line references.

The repository is a small static site, so the main risks are concentrated in crawl policy, machine-readable entity data, and whether the public pages answer high-intent queries completely enough for search and AI systems. I’m now pinning each finding to source lines and separating definite defects from recommendations.

**Audit result:** The public pages are crawlable and have basic titles, descriptions, canonicals, and semantic headings, but GEO readiness is weak. The largest defect is that AI search crawling is explicitly blocked.

| Priority | File / lines | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Critical** | `robots.txt:5-6` | `GPTBot` is blocked from the entire site, contradicting `geo.config.json:1`, which says AI search crawlers are allowed. | Remove the `GPTBot` block or explicitly allow intended AI search crawlers. Treat `geo.config.json` as documentation/config only; crawlers follow `robots.txt`. |
| **High** | `index.html:3-10`, `breads.html:3-10`, `classes.html:3-10` | No JSON-LD structured data. Search engines and AI systems receive no explicit `LocalBusiness`, `Product`, `Course`, `Offer`, or `BreadcrumbList` entities. | Add valid schema.org JSON-LD. Use `Bakery/LocalBusiness` site-wide, `Product`/`Offer` for breads, and `Course`/`Event` for classes. |
| **High** | `index.html:14-17` | Local business identity is incomplete: no address, phone, opening hours, service area, ordering URL, or same-as profiles. | Add consistent NAP details, hours, collection location, contact/order links, and corresponding `LocalBusiness` schema. |
| **High** | `classes.html:14-15` | The class page does not provide dates, duration, price, capacity, location, instructor, availability, or a booking link. It cannot answer common “bread class” queries. | Add a structured class schedule, price, booking CTA, location, cancellation details, and `Course`/`Event` data. |
| **Medium** | `breads.html:14-16` | The bread catalogue is not actually a catalogue: no individual bread names beyond two examples, ingredients, prices, sizes, availability, collection details, or ordering links. | Create individual product entries with stable URLs, descriptive copy, price/availability, ingredients/allergens, and `Product` schema. |
| **Medium** | `breads.html:16` | `data-nosnippet` hides the allergen warning from search snippets and potentially AI-generated answers. | Remove `data-nosnippet`; publish complete allergen information visibly and accurately. |
| **Medium** | `index.html:6-8`, `breads.html:6-8`, `classes.html:6-8` | No Open Graph or Twitter/X metadata, reducing control over link previews and share-generated discovery. | Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `og:type`, and equivalent Twitter metadata. |
| **Conditional critical** | `index.html:8`, `breads.html:8`, `classes.html:8`, `sitemap.xml:3-5`, `geo.config.json:1` | The canonical origin is `https://www.millstonebakery.example`, a reserved placeholder domain. If this is deployed literally, indexing and canonicalization will point to the wrong host. | Replace every `.example` URL with the real production origin before launch. |

`members/index.html:8-9` and `robots.txt:3` correctly keep the private members area out of indexing; that part should be retained.
